title: Building the semantic intelligence layer for enterprise AI agents
abstract: Every AI agent in the enterprise reasons better when it shares a common semantic understanding of the business. Shows how to build an Agentic Intelligence Layer that resolves meaning across every system and makes it consumable by any agent. Combines semantic embeddings, knowledge graph relationships, and natural-language memories into a single governed layer every agent reads from and writes back to. Product and customer intelligence as the first domains; extends to supply chain, operations, finance, workforce. Real-estate lens: this is the pattern for a property/listing knowledge layer.

title: Building the semantic intelligence layer for enterprise AI agents [REPEAT]
abstract: Repeat of IND367-R. Build an Agentic Intelligence Layer combining semantic embeddings, knowledge graph relationships, and natural-language memories into a single governed layer every agent reads from and writes back to.

title: Accelerate intelligent document processing with Amazon Textract
abstract: Building custom extraction pipelines on foundation models is powerful but expensive to maintain. Textract Intelligence gives the same GenAI flexibility as a managed service: custom-field extraction, document classification, splitting, and summarization, backed by purpose-built OCR instead of a vision model guessing at pixels. Compares approaches head-to-head on accuracy, latency, and cost, then shows how 40-language support and confidence scores close the gaps that push teams to DIY. Real-estate lens: leases, disclosures, appraisals.

title: Introducing AWS Context: Build governed intelligence for agents at scale
abstract: AI agents need to understand what your data means, how it connects, and which definitions and rules apply. AWS Context automatically builds a governed knowledge graph by unifying structured and unstructured data, managed knowledge bases, and technical and business metadata from AWS and third-party sources. Dives into the reference architecture and best practices for integrating agents with AWS Context, including identity management, workload sizing, and production deployments.

title: Unlock intelligent AI with MCP-powered agentic Neptune graph reasoning
abstract: Graph-based agentic reasoning empowers AI systems to dynamically interact with the rich context and relationships in an Amazon Neptune graph. Build a generative AI application for investment analysis spanning the full lifecycle, from raw unstructured data to autonomous AI agents, combining Neptune, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and MCP. Extract entities and relationships from raw EDGAR data, build a domain knowledge graph, surface actionable insights from graph relationships, build an agent to find investment analysis trends.

title: Turn log storage into log intelligence
abstract: Bring logs, metrics, and traces into a unified data store for analytics and improved troubleshooting. Centralization rules bring telemetry together across accounts and regions, telemetry pipelines enrich and route data in flight, intelligence tiering matches storage cost to query value, and AI-assisted log analytics surface answers instead of waiting for the right question. Leave with an architecture for unified log analytics.

title: World Models & Physical AI: The Next Frontier in Intelligent Systems
abstract: World models, AI systems that simulate and predict complex environments, are emerging with new modalities including Video, Vision, Language, Action to power physical AI, autonomous systems, and real-time video generation. From humanoid robotics to immersive entertainment, these models transform how machines perceive, think, and interact with the physical world. Panel with researchers and customers on building and deploying world models in production, business opportunities, and technical challenges.

title: One agent, any robot: building physical AI with Strands Robots
abstract: Physical AI puts agents in the real world. Builds a robotics agent with the Strands Robots SDK: one Robot() call gives an agent hands, a MuJoCo simulation by default, real hardware with one code parameter change. Whiteboards the loop around the embodied agent: perception, a vision-language-action policy (GR00T, Cosmos 3, LeRobot), and low-level control. Covers the edge-to-cloud intelligence split, the peer-to-peer mesh and AWS IoT bridge coordinating a fleet, and sim-to-real transfer.

title: AI agents are crawling your website? Identify, optimize, rate-limit, & monetize them
abstract: AI agents are the new web visitors. Deploy a Single Page Application on CloudFront, S3, API Gateway, Lambda, and Bedrock, then progressively secure and monetize AI agent traffic. Integrate AWS WAF Bot Control to identify agents via the WBA protocol, implement intelligent routing in CloudFront Functions to serve optimized content per visitor type, enforce rate limits by bot identity and resource consumption, enable AI Traffic Monetization in WAF using the x402 payment protocol with a Bedrock AgentCore. Real-estate lens: how a listings site treats agent crawler traffic.

title: Practical applications of edge compute in Amazon CloudFront
abstract: Edge compute is a practical way to build faster, smarter applications. How Amazon CloudFront runs custom logic at the edge using CloudFront Functions, Lambda@Edge, and the Key Value Store. Real-world use cases, architectural patterns, and recent feature launches unlocking personalization, performance optimization, and cost efficiency. Real-estate lens: low-latency global property browsing (the LockHouse Lagos-edge pattern).
